name: Bad Medicine
summary: At the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, Sergeant Yohwa seeks to blunt Colonel Kurzen's military advantage by targeting his medical support. The renegades rely on powerful remedies and toxins concocted by their practitioners, leaving the resistance fighters desperate to turn those same concoctions to their own advantage.

sections.title: Stripping the Compound's Support
sections.body: Colonel Kurzen has bolstered his jungle force with numerous medicine men who heal his forces and poison Yohwa's fighters with venom fern extracts. To turn the tide of the conflict, Sergeant Yohwa directs adventurers into the Kurzen Compound to scavenge those vital supplies. Securing their jungle remedies will help treat wounded fighters at the Rebel Camp, while capturing a sample of their venom fern extract will enable the resistance to study the toxin and manufacture their own cures.

faq.answer: Sergeant Yohwa, stationed at the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, asks you to retrieve these medical supplies.

faq.q: Why does Sergeant Yohwa want Jungle Remedies?
faq.answer: Kurzen's medicine men use the remedies to heal their own soldiers. The resistance fighters need those same supplies to treat and sustain their own wounded comrades.

faq.q: What is the Venom Fern Extract used for?
faq.answer: Kurzen's forces use the venom fern extract to poison Yohwa's fighters. Sergeant Yohwa needs a sample so the camp can study the compound and brew their own remedies against it.

faq.q: Where are these medical supplies kept?
faq.answer: Both are held within the Kurzen Compound. The medicine men carry the remedies directly, while the venom fern extracts are stowed inside supply boxes around the encampment.

angles.text: Cutting off Kurzen's healing support keeps more of the Rebel Camp's fighters alive against his forces.
